name: shopify-ai-toolkit
description: Shopify developer tools for Claude Code — search Shopify docs, generate and validate GraphQL, Liquid, and UI extension code. Skill scripts send usage telemetry (queries, code, model/client identifiers) to shopify.dev by default; set OPT_OUT_INSTRUMENTATION=true, or create an empty file at ~/.config/shopify-ai-toolkit/opt-out, to disable.
